prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one wide 16:9 background plate for a handcrafted felt story animation, requested 2048 x 1152.
Primary request: A moonlit wooden bridge near a small colonial church in Sleepy Hollow, New York, around 1790, all represented as an exquisitely handcrafted needle-felt storybook diorama. One complete coherent wide landscape.
Composition: clear BROADSIDE FRONT VIEW of a wooden bridge spanning a narrow brook horizontally LEFT TO RIGHT across the lower half of the image. The flat deck's walking surface is at 75 percent of image height, an uninterrupted horizontal standing line. Road connects smoothly to the left and right ends. The bridge is wide enough for horse and rider. There is NO NEAR-SIDE railing in front of the walking surface, so animated horses' hooves will be completely visible making contact with the deck. A very low wooden edge or restrained far-side railing is okay. Stream and dark felt stones below, supporting wooden structure visible under deck. A small white colonial church with modest steeple stands on a hill in the background beyond the RIGHT end of the bridge. Autumn woods beyond and framing edges, with the middle and crossing route clear.
Style: children's storybook needle-felt wool diorama, detailed fuzzy fibers, layered felt leaves and trees, softly sculpted handmade wooden boards and stone. Cinematic beautiful readable palette, every surface clearly made of wool or fabric rather than a real photograph.
Lighting: silver moonlight on the entire bridge deck, navy and teal woods, quiet cool moonlit sky, some muted ochre and russet autumn leaves. Enough light to see the architecture and clear crossing. Calm still environment.
Constraints: NO people, NO animals, NO riders, NO ghosts or supernatural entities, NO text, NO lettering, NO logos, NO watermark, NO border, NO collage, NO modern objects, NO snow, NO Christmas decoration. No foreground foliage covering the deck, no bridge that recedes into distance, no high rails obscuring feet, no dense fog over the bridge. Output one full landscape image.
edit_prompt: Edit the provided handcrafted felt storybook bridge background. Preserve the exact wool diorama style, autumn trees, moonlit navy/teal palette, small white colonial church on the right, horizontal broadside wooden bridge and open unobstructed deck with only a low FAR-side railing. Change only the vertical composition: MOVE THE BRIDGE DOWN so the TOP WALKING SURFACE is at 76 PERCENT OF THE FULL IMAGE HEIGHT (about three quarters of the way down). The bottom of the bridge structure should lie near 90 percent height; only a small band of brook remains below it. Enlarge the empty woodland and night sky area ABOVE THE BRIDGE, keeping a large clear central space for horse and rider animated cutouts. Both road ends must meet the bridge smoothly at the same horizontal 76 percent image-height level. Keep the church on the hill behind at upper right, naturally fitting the recentered scene. No people, animals, riders, text, logos, ghosts, snow, or collage. One complete wide 16:9 2048x1152 landscape. The deck must NOT be around the middle: it is in the LOWER QUARTER of the image.
inspection: Both generated results inspected visually. Initial bridge stood too high, so a built-in image_gen edit moved its deck to lower quarter. Final deck is roughly y=0.765 to 0.805, suitable center footing y=0.785. Horizontal road connects to each end. Far-side low rail only; hooves remain visible. Felt church at right, bright readable navy moonlight, no people animals or text. Final result copied unchanged.
